materials.name: forest-grass
materials.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game terrain SIDE texture sheet, flat rectangular UV texture, 1:2 portrait aspect ratio, 1024x2048. A hand-painted detailed medieval woodland tactical RPG material. Orthographic FRONT view of a vertical exposed earth cross-section, absolutely no perspective, no isometric shape, no visible top plane. Fill entire rectangle edge-to-edge with opaque material. Texture must tile seamlessly left-to-right. One continuous soil column down the full height, not a sheet of repeating blocks. Neutral diffuse light, no baked directional shadow, no vignette, no border, no text, no labels, no watermark, no sky, no empty background. The engine shrinks this to 128x256 and for a low ledge displays ONLY the TOP one-eighth: therefore surface fringe must be exceptionally THIN, confined to the first 2 percent of image height; even the first eighth must mostly show rich brown soil texture. Below that, progressively compact brown earth, subtle horizontal natural sediment, occasional tiny embedded pebbles; roots taper away with depth. Readable material at small game scale, restrained natural colors, no bricks or dressed masonry. Material: mossy meadow turf bank. A thin olive green moss and short cut grass rim along the very top edge, dark umber root-bearing loam immediately below, muted olive-brown soil, a few fine winding roots and small grey-brown stones deeper down. Match the yellow-green olive woodland grass palette; mostly earthy brown, not solid green.
